_doc: Purchase orders excluded from the monthly Expenses tab. Used by sync_accounting.ts. Add a PO here when it shouldn't count as a real expense — e.g. an artificial PO created in Loyverse to patch a stock discrepancy.

excluded.reason: Artificial PO created in Loyverse to fix a stock discrepancy — not a real purchase.
Entered by mistake with wrong prices; already reversed by a manual stock adjustment (reason: loss). Not a real purchase — must not count as an expense or a payable.
